verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms Phaser's engine source is publicly hosted on GitHub (phaser-gh-1, phaser-gh-2), implying developers can view and fork the code, but the pack never cites an explicit license statement or confirms unrestricted modification rights for the core engine itself. The licensing/pricing references (phaser-docs-16, phaser-docs-30) pertain to the separate paid Editor product, not the open engine, so they don't clarify engine-level openness. Missing for 10: explicit license text (e.g., MIT) for the core engine, and confirmation/testimony of developers actually forking or patching engine internals.
